description: Deciduous tree fruit; needs cross-pollination from another apple variety. Chill hours required.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring; avoid excess nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; thin fruit. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Codling moth, apple maggot, fire blight, aphids.
symptoms: Yellow leaves = overwater or nutrient lack; spots = fire blight or scab.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; seeds contain amygdalin (cyanide precursor) - don't eat seeds in quantity.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (apple sauce, pie filling)
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs pollinator variety nearby; prune dormant season.

description: Small-fruited apple tree; excellent pollinator for other apples and ornamental.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Codling moth, fire blight, apple scab, aphids.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; spots = fire blight or scab.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (crabapple jelly)
pinching_bolting_notes: Good pollinator tree; prune dormant season.

description: Deciduous tree fruit; often needs cross-pollination. Fire blight susceptible.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring; low nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; thin fruit. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Fire blight, codling moth, pear psylla, aphids.
symptoms: Blackened shoots = fire blight; yellow = overwater.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2.5 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (pear halves, spiced pears)
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs pollinator; harvest firm and ripen off-tree.

description: Stone fruit tree; often self-fertile but better with pollinator.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune in summer (avoid winter pruning - disease). Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Plum curculio, brown rot, aphids, black knot.
symptoms: Black swollen branches = black knot; brown fruit rot = brown rot.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2.5 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (plum jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Prune in summer only (disease risk in winter).

description: Stone fruit tree; birds love fruit - net the tree.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Birds, cherry fruit fly, brown rot, aphids.
symptoms: Cracked fruit = irregular water/rain; brown rot = fungal disease.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2.5 cups pitted; water_bath_canning (cherry pie filling, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Net against birds; harvest when fully colored.

description: Stone fruit tree; self-fertile. Needs chill hours and good drainage.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune to open center; thin fruit. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Peach tree borer, brown rot, aphids, leaf curl.
symptoms: Curled red leaves = peach leaf curl; brown rot = fungal.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (peach halves, jam)
pinching_bolting_notes: Thin fruit for size; open-center pruning.

description: Smooth-skinned peach; self-fertile. Similar care to peach.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune to open center; thin fruit. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Peach tree borer, brown rot, aphids, leaf curl.
symptoms: Curled leaves = leaf curl; brown fruit = brown rot.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (nectarine halves, jam)
pinching_bolting_notes: Same care as peach; thin fruit for size.

description: Early-blooming stone fruit; frost-sensitive blossoms.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune in summer. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Brown rot, aphids, plum curculio.
symptoms: Brown blossoms = frost or blossom blight; brown rot = fungal.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (apricot halves, jam)
pinching_bolting_notes: Early blooms frost-sensitive; summer pruning only.

description: Deciduous tree/shrub with sweet fruit. Often self-fertile; container-friendly.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer monthly in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Fig rust, nematodes, birds.
symptoms: Leaf drop = overwater or cold; rust = fungal disease.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (fig jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Container-friendly; harvest when soft and drooping.

description: Low-growing perennial with runners; everbearing or June-bearing types.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer at planting and after first harvest.
grooming_propagation: Renovate after harvest; manage runners. Propagate by runners.
common_pests: Slugs, birds, spider mites, gray mold.
symptoms: Soft fruit = gray mold; yellow = overwater or nutrient lack.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups hulled; water_bath_canning (jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Renovate beds after fruiting; control runners.

description: Acid-loving shrub; needs soil pH 4.5-5.5. Cross-pollination improves yield.
fertilizing: Acid fertilizer (azalea/rhododendron) in spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; remove old canes. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Birds, blueberry maggot, mummy berry, aphids.
symptoms: Yellow leaves = high soil pH (chlorosis); fruit drop = drought.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups; water_bath_canning (jam, pie filling)
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs acidic soil (pH 4.5-5.5); cross-pollinate varieties.

description: Cane fruit; summer-bearing or everbearing. Needs trellis/support.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune canes after fruiting. Propagate by suckers/cuttings.
common_pests: Cane borer, spider mites, gray mold, raspberry fruit worm.
symptoms: Withered canes = cane borer; gray mold = fungal.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups; water_bath_canning (jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Prune fruited canes after harvest; trellis canes.

description: Cane fruit; thornless varieties available. Vigorous and spreading.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune floricanes after fruiting. Propagate by tip layering/suckers.
common_pests: Cane borer, spider mites, gray mold.
symptoms: Withered canes = cane borer; moldy fruit = fungal.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups; water_bath_canning (jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Prune fruited canes after harvest; trellis vigorous canes.

description: Woody vine needing strong trellis. Annual pruning essential for fruit.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring if growth is weak.
grooming_propagation: Heavy dormant pruning; trellis required. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Grape berry moth, Japanese beetle, powdery mildew, birds.
symptoms: White powdery leaves = mildew; poor fruit = lack of pruning/sun.
toxicity_notes: Safe for humans; grapes/raisins toxic to dogs.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups; water_bath_canning (grape juice, jelly)
pinching_bolting_notes: Heavy annual dormant pruning; strong trellis required.

description: Small smooth-skinned kiwi; needs male and female vines for fruit. Vigorous climber.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring and early summer.
grooming_propagation: Prune annually; strong trellis/pergola required. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Spider mites, root rot, cats (chew vines).
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nutrient lack; root rot = poor drainage.
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs male + female vines; strong trellis required.

description: Compact citrus tree/shrub; sweeter than standard lemon. Container-friendly.
fertilizing: Citrus fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune to shape; harvest when fully yellow. Propagate by grafting/cuttings.
common_pests: Spider mites, scale, aphids, mealybugs, citrus leaf miner.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nutrient deficiency; leaf drop = cold draft.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; oils irritate pets if eaten in quantity.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups juiced/zested; water_bath_canning (lemon curd, marmalade)
pinching_bolting_notes: Container-friendly; bring indoors in cold zones.

description: Seedless lime tree; needs warmth and bright light. Container-friendly.
fertilizing: Citrus fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune to shape; harvest when full size. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Spider mites, scale, aphids, mealybugs.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nutrient deficiency; leaf drop = cold.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; oils irritate pets if eaten in quantity.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups juiced/zested; water_bath_canning (lime curd, marmalade)
pinching_bolting_notes: Container-friendly; needs consistent warmth.

description: Sweet seedless orange tree; needs heat and bright light.
fertilizing: Citrus fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune to shape; harvest when fully colored. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Spider mites, scale, aphids, mealybugs.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nutrient deficiency; fruit drop = stress.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; oils irritate pets if eaten in quantity.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups juiced/zested; water_bath_canning (orange marmalade)
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs sustained heat; harvest when fully colored.

description: Large citrus fruit; needs heat and space. Bitter-sweet flavor.
fertilizing: Citrus fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune to shape; harvest when heavy and full size. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Spider mites, scale, aphids, mealybugs.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nutrient deficiency; fruit drop = stress.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; oils irritate pets if eaten in quantity.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups juiced/zested; water_bath_canning (grapefruit marmalade)
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs heat and space; harvest when full size.

description: Easy-peel mandarin orange; cold-hardier than most citrus.
fertilizing: Citrus fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune to shape; harvest when orange and easy-peel. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Spider mites, scale, aphids, mealybugs.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nutrient deficiency; fruit drop = stress.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; oils irritate pets if eaten in quantity.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups juiced/zested; water_bath_canning (mandarin marmalade)
pinching_bolting_notes: Cold-hardier citrus; harvest when easy-peel.

description: Tropical bromeliad; grows from crown. One fruit per plant, then slips/suckers.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 6-8 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Harvest fruit; propagate from crown, slips, or suckers.
common_pests: Mealybugs, scale, root rot.
symptoms: Yellow leaves = overwater; small fruit = nutrient lack.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups cubed; water_bath_canning (pineapple chunks, jam)
pinching_bolting_notes: One fruit per plant; propagate from crown after harvest.

description: Drought-tolerant shrub/small tree with leathery-skinned fruit.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; thin fruit. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Aphids, whiteflies, fruit rot.
symptoms: Fruit rot = wet weather; yellow = overwater.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups seeds/juice; water_bath_canning (pomegranate jelly, syrup)
pinching_bolting_notes: Drought tolerant; thin fruit to prevent branch breakage.

description: Herbaceous tropical; large leaves, sweet fruit. Needs warmth and water.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer monthly in growing season; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Cut pseudostem after fruiting; pups replace it. Propagate by pups/suckers.
common_pests: Spider mites, aphids, root rot.
symptoms: Torn leaves = wind; yellow = overwater or cold.
pinching_bolting_notes: Cut pseudostem after fruiting; pups replace it.

description: Fast-growing tropical tree; single-stem. Male/female/hermaphrodite types.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer every 4-6 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Single-stem; harvest when skin turns yellow. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Papaya fruit fly, aphids, spider mites, root rot.
symptoms: Stem rot = overwater; fruit drop = stress.
pinching_bolting_notes: Single-stem short-lived tree; propagate by seed.

description: Large tropical evergreen tree; needs heat and space. Grafted varieties fruit sooner.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer every 6-8 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune to shape; harvest when skin changes color. Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Anthracnose, powdery mildew, mango hopper, scale.
symptoms: Black spots = anthracnose; fruit drop = stress.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; sap can irritate skin (anacardic acid).
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs heat and space; grafted trees fruit sooner.

description: Evergreen avocado tree; needs frost-free climate. Type A flowering.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer monthly in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune minimally; harvest when mature (ripens off-tree). Propagate by grafting.
common_pests: Root rot, spider mites, avocado thrips.
symptoms: Leaf drop = overwater/cold; root rot = poor drainage.
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe for humans; toxic to dogs/cats/birds (persin).
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest mature fruit; ripens off-tree. Frost sensitive.

description: Warm-season melon with smooth pale rind and green flesh. Needs heat.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Give vines space or trellis with slings. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Cucumber beetles, aphids, powdery mildew.
symptoms: Bland fruit = insufficient heat; yellow leaves = mildew.
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs sustained heat; trellis fruits with slings.

description: Climbing cactus with dramatic pink fruit. Needs support and warmth.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid monthly in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Train on sturdy post/trellis; propagate by stem cuttings.
common_pests: Scale, mealybugs, stem rot.
symptoms: Stem rot = overwater; yellow = sunburn or cold.
pinching_bolting_notes: Train on sturdy support; night-blooming flowers hand-pollinate.

description: Fast-growing tropical vine with aromatic fruit. Needs strong trellis.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid monthly in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Strong trellis required; prune annually. Propagate by cuttings/seed.
common_pests: Aphids, spider mites, root knot nematodes.
symptoms: Fruit drop = poor pollination or stress; yellow = overwater.
pinching_bolting_notes: Strong trellis required; hand-pollination may help fruit set.

description: Fast-growing deciduous tree with abundant sweet berries. Messy - plant away from paths.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; harvest by shaking branches. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Scale, whiteflies, powdery mildew.
symptoms: Leaf drop = overwater/cold; sparse fruit = nutrient lack.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups; water_bath_canning (mulberry jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Plant away from paths (messy fruit); harvest by shaking branches.

description: Shrub with clusters of dark berries; flowers and cooked berries edible. Raw berries toxic.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; harvest cooked berries only. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Aphids, cane borer, powdery mildew.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; poor fruit = lack of pollinator.
toxicity_notes: Raw berries/leaves/stems toxic (cyanogenic glycosides); cook berries before eating.
pinching_bolting_notes: Cook berries before eating (raw toxic); prune dormant winter.

description: Spiny shrub with tart green/red berries. Prefers cool summers.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter to open center. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Gooseberry sawfly, aphids, powdery mildew.
symptoms: Defoliated = sawfly; white powder = mildew.
pinching_bolting_notes: Prune to open center; prefers cool summers.

description: Shrub with dark tart berries high in vitamin C. Prefers cool climates.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer in early spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune oldest wood in winter. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Aphids, currant borer, powdery mildew.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; sparse fruit = old wood.
pinching_bolting_notes: Remove oldest wood each winter; cool climate preferred.

description: Cold-hardier fig cultivar with brown-purple fruit. Reliable producer.
fertilizing: Balanced fertilizer monthly in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Prune dormant winter; propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Fig rust, nematodes, birds.
symptoms: Leaf drop = overwater/cold; rust = fungal.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups sliced; water_bath_canning (fig jam, preserves)
pinching_bolting_notes: Cold-hardier fig; harvest when soft and drooping.

description: Low-growing evergreen shrub for boggy acidic soil. Tart red berries.
fertilizing: Acid fertilizer in spring.
grooming_propagation: Prune lightly; keep soil consistently moist and acidic. Propagate by cuttings.
common_pests: Fruitworm, spanworm, root rot.
symptoms: Yellow = high pH (chlorosis); fruit rot = wet conditions.
pinching_bolting_notes: Needs boggy acidic soil; keep consistently moist.
